subject: Onboarding: IronBridge compliance deep-dive & SOC 2 evidence sync
messages:
From: Claire Donovan <claire.donovan@ironbridge.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@ironbridge.com
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance deep-dive requested — SOC 2 evidence + architecture review

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — we had a good internal discussion and the security team wants a focused architecture review before we move to procurement. Primary asks:

- Walkthrough of network boundary, encryption at rest/in-flight, and key management options.
- Evidence map for SOC 2 (where audit logs, retention, change-control artifacts live).
- SSO integration options (Okta) and audit log hooks.

Can we book a 45–60 minute deep-dive next week? Our preferred times: Tue May 4 between 10:00–14:00 PT or Wed May 5 after 13:00 PT. Attendees will include me (security lead) and Tom Alvarez (infra).

If helpful, I attached the baseline questionnaire our compliance team uses — feel free to flag anything you need ahead of time.

Appreciate it,
Claire

--
Claire Donovan
Security Program Manager | IronBridge Systems
claire.donovan@ironbridge.com
[Attachment: IronBridge_Security_Questions_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 78 KB)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire.donovan@ironbridge.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance deep-dive requested — SOC 2 evidence + architecture review

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear asks and for sending the questionnaire. Happy to run this. Proposed items for the session:

1) High-level architecture walkthrough (network boundaries, model-serving tiers, private vs hosted controls) — Logan (me) + short slide deck.
2) Encryption & key management (KMS/HSM options, customer-managed keys) — Mina Haddad (security eng).
3) Audit logs & retention (where logs are stored, retention policies, export) — Aisha Rahman (ops).
4) SOC 2 evidence mapping & next steps for evidence handoff.

Available slots on our side that match your window:
- Tue May 4, 10:30–11:30 PT
- Tue May 4, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Wed May 5, 14:00–15:00 PT

I attached a short pre-meeting agenda and our architecture diagram to give your team context. If any of those times work, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a shared Drive link for the evidence mapping table.

Best,
Logan
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0184
[Attachments: pre-meeting-agenda.pdf (application/pdf, 42 KB); redwood-arch-diagram.png (image/png, 220 KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire.donovan@ironbridge.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance deep-dive requested — SOC 2 evidence + architecture review

Claire / Logan — quick note from the security engineering side. For the deep-dive, could you confirm whether IronBridge needs:

- Customer-managed KMS (CMK) vs Redwood-managed keys? (affects slides and demo)
- Specific retention window for audit logs (90/365/other) so I can pull retention config examples.
- Any scope exclusions (e.g., only want hosted API, not Private deploys)?

Also, if you can pre-fill the top 5 rows of the questionnaire (business owner, env scope, expected data classes), it will speed the call. I’ll bring examples of our SOC 2 artifacts and an exportable audit-log sample.

Thanks — Mina
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@ironbridge.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Claire Donovan <claire.donovan@ironbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance deep-dive requested — SOC 2 evidence + architecture review

Hi all,

Sorry to jump in — our infra lead is out unexpectedly on Tue morning and we won’t be available for the 10:30 slot. We can do Tue 13:00 PT or Wed 14:00 PT as alternatives. If Tue 13:00 works, we prefer that.

Also, Claire — I started filling the questionnaire and uploaded network diagrams to the shared link (I’ll send a separate note with the link).

—Tom

Thanks Tom — Tue May 4 at 13:00 PT is confirmed from our side. I’ve booked a 60-minute slot to give some buffer for questions. Calendar invite and a short Loom walkthrough (pre-read) are linked here: https://cal.com/redwood/30min?c=ironbridge (will update with recording afterward).

Agenda in the invite: 1) Architecture walkthrough (20m) 2) Encryption & KMS options (15m) 3) Audit logs & evidence mapping (15m) 4) Next steps / evidence handoff (10m).

Action items prior to meeting:
- Claire/Tom: if possible, complete the top section of the questionnaire and attach the network diagram to the HubSpot deal record.
- Mina/Aisha: prepare sample audit export and KMS config examples.

See you Tue 13:00 PT — invite sent from calendar@redwood.com.
